tools.name: comet_connect
tools.description: Connect to Comet browser (auto-starts if needed)

tools.name: comet_ask
tools.description: Send a prompt to Comet/Perplexity and wait for the complete response (blocking). Ideal for tasks requiring real browser interaction (login walls, dynamic content, filling forms) or deep research with agentic browsing.

prompt.description: Question or task for Comet - focus on goals and context

tools.name: comet_poll
tools.description: Check agent status and progress. Call repeatedly to monitor agentic tasks.

tools.name: comet_stop
tools.description: Stop the current agent task if it's going off track

tools.name: comet_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of current page

tools.name: comet_mode
tools.description: Switch Perplexity search mode. Modes: 'search' (basic), 'research' (deep research), 'labs' (analytics/visualization), 'learn' (educational). Call without mode to see current mode.

mode.description: Mode to switch to (optional - omit to see current mode)
